lines.text: Five minutes before a visit, most AI tools hand you eighteen months of chart — compressed, paraphrased, and hard to trust.
Huddle shows three things instead. What you've been working on: each problem from your last three visits, with the plan you wrote.
What's falling off: problems untouched for ten months or more, and where you left them.
And HCCs not yet captured this year, so nothing clinically real slips past documentation.
lines.say: And H C C's not yet captured this year, so nothing clinically real slips past documentation.

lines.text: Your own words, not an AI paraphrase. Huddle comes with every Stream subscription.
Try Stream free for 30 days. No credit card required.
